name: Ame-chan Wakuwaku Date Game
original_name: あめちゃん わくわくデートゲーム
source:
A retro-style visual novel where you get to experience a rare date scene that can't be seen in the main game. Take Ame to a nice place and give her the time of her life!

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757490]Steam[/url]]
